scope: Real Chromium and real clipboard; synthetic HTTP fixtures; no MIS/ASR/model execution
checks: Archive warnings remain visible while saved calls are usable
Archive response panel is to the right of the call
Actual browser clipboard contains exact FIO, NULL, JSON, empty and long values
Every parameter and SQL text has a working copy control
Right panel resizes with real pointer and keyboard
Clipboard API denial falls back to actual execCommand copy
Clipboard failure gives visible manual-copy instruction
Changing calls clears previous result and clipboard feedback
Empty query and missing result are distinguished
Late archive response cannot replace the newer selection
Live onStep response populates the same right panel
Real pointer docks MIS at the top without remounting its React content
Docked top panel supports keyboard height resizing
Actual pointer moves the panel to all four edges while retaining its React subtree
Floating panel resizes in both dimensions with real pointer and keyboard
Escape cancels a panel drag without changing saved layout
Keyboard-accessible placement control docks calls at the bottom
Panel placement, size and dark theme survive reload
Reset restores calls-left and MIS-right defaults
Read-only help renders exact repository document text and does not offer the admin editor to observer
900px layout keeps the response adjacent without page overflow
390px screen has no page overflow and supports copying
